description.sl: Poklici s kovačem Brunom: vodovodar in električar, odvetnik in novinar, inženir in arhitekt, računovodja in lekarnar, natakar in frizer, prodajalec in delavec, uradnik, kuhar in pek, mehanik, krojač in čevljar, gasilec, poštar, obrtnik, poklic in obrt.
description.en: Trades and jobs with Fabbro Bruno: the plumber and the electrician, the lawyer and the journalist, the engineer and the architect, the accountant and the pharmacist, the waiter and the hairdresser, the shop assistant and the factory worker, the office worker, the baker, the mechanic, the tailor and the shoemaker, the craftsman, the trade.
description.de: Berufe mit Fabbro Bruno: Installateur und Elektriker, Anwalt und Journalist, Ingenieur und Architekt, Steuerberater und Apotheker, Kellner und Friseur, Verkäufer und Arbeiter, der Büroangestellte, der Bäcker, der Mechaniker, Schneider und Schuster, der Handwerker, das Handwerk.

review: it, sl, en, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
